preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call changeFees() function
Attacker must hold some KARMA tokens to execute a sell transaction

exploit_hint: As owner, call changeFees() to set totalFeeSell = 0, then sell tokens. This triggers division by zero in swapBack() when calculating fee distribution (marketingFeeSell.div(totalBNBFee) where totalBNBFee = totalFeeSell - reflectionFeeSell = 0 - reflectionFeeSell = negative value that underflows). The exploit causes the contract to send all BNB balance to fee receivers while skipping proper calculations, potentially allowing fee receiver manipulation for economic gain.
